decisions.thought:
Dragapult is at -1 Speed (280) due to Sticky Web, meaning Ogerpon-Wellspring (up to 350 Speed) outspeeds and will likely KO Dragapult at 23% HP. 

However, switching risks taking heavy damage on healthy switch-ins (like Gholdengo or Kingambit) to Knock Off or Ivy Cudgel. If Ogerpon attacks, Dragapult faints cleanly, giving a free switch into Gholdengo or Dragonite (for Extreme Speed revenge kill). If Ogerpon uses Swords Dance or utility, Specs Draco Meteor completely obliterates it (87.7 - 103.6% chance to OHKO). Draco Meteor is the highest-value, zero-risk play.

Opponent has Ogerpon-Wellspring and one unknown left. Our side has Sticky Web and Spikes.
Gholdengo holds Air Balloon, completely ignoring entry hazards (no Spikes damage, no Sticky Web speed drop) on switch-in. It resists Grass-type Ivy Cudgel and threatens huge immediate damage with Make It Rain or Shadow Ball, putting immense pressure on Ogerpon.

Ogerpon-Wellspring is faster and cannot OHKO full HP Gholdengo even with Knock Off. Make It Rain is resisted by Water, making Shadow Ball the best STAB option to deal massive neutral damage (over 55-65%), putting Ogerpon well within range of priority revenge kills if Gholdengo falls, or 2HKOing it directly.
